items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Mat is pretty cool. Mat is very cool. He is so laid back... But sometimes he really has an opinion about it... generally up to the band leader on those sessions.

ctx.x: How much control do you get over — I mean you have a producer whose in a sense paying for the session?
